sloka: एष ते सर्पसङ्काशो बाणः पास्यति शोणितम्।मृगराज इव क्रुद्धो नागराजस्य शोणितम्।इत्येवमुक्त्वा सङ्क्रुद्धः शरं धनुषि सन्दधे ।। ६.७१.५६ ।।
transliteration: eṣa te sarpasaṅkāśo bāṇaḥ pāsyati śoṇitam।mṛgarāja iva kruddho nāgarājasya śoṇitam।ityevamuktvā saṅkruddhaḥ śaraṁ dhanuṣi sandadhe ।। 6.71.56 ।।

translations.english: "These arrows are like serpents and can drink your blood just as an angry lion drinks the blood of elephants. Therefore, I tell you", said Atikaya to Lakshmana."
